claim: Brings PINN-style physical residual supervision into DeepONet learning across input functions.
claim_zh: 将微分方程残差与边界条件损失用于跨实例算子训练。
innovation_detail: Inject differential-equation residual and boundary losses into multi-instance operator training.
innovation_detail_zh: 将微分方程残差与边界条件损失用于跨实例算子训练。
bottleneck: Purely supervised operators may require extensive paired simulation labels.
bottleneck_zh: 纯监督算子学习可能需要大量配对数值模拟标签。
tradeoff: Physics penalties are typically soft and do not guarantee exact conservation.
